title: Wave nature of electrons
motivation: Discovery of the wave nature of electrons.
explanation: A foundational quantum-mechanics result that later underpinned electron microscopy and modern solid-state physics.

title: Atomic theory and quantum mechanics
motivation: New productive forms of atomic theory.
explanation: Among the deepest foundations of quantum mechanics, with enormous downstream technological consequences across electronics, photonics and quantum devices.

title: Penicillin
motivation: Discovery of penicillin and its curative effect in infectious diseases.
explanation: A biomedical discovery translated rapidly into one of the most consequential therapeutic technologies in history.

title: Transistor effect
motivation: Research on semiconductors and discovery of the transistor effect.
explanation: Semiconductor physics became the basis of modern electronics, computing, communications and integrated circuits.

title: Molecular structure of DNA
motivation: Discoveries concerning the molecular structure of nucleic acids and its significance for information transfer in living material.
explanation: A fundamental biological insight that became the conceptual basis of genomics, biotechnology, diagnostics and modern molecular medicine.

title: Maser-laser principle
motivation: Fundamental work in quantum electronics leading to oscillators and amplifiers based on the maser-laser principle.
explanation: Quantum electronics translated into lasers, transforming communications, manufacturing, medicine, sensing and science.

title: Theory of superconductivity
motivation: Jointly developed theory of superconductivity, usually called BCS theory.
explanation: A highly fundamental condensed-matter theory with important technological applications in MRI, magnets, sensors and quantum systems.

title: Direct methods for crystal structures
motivation: Outstanding achievements in development of direct methods for determination of crystal structures.
explanation: Methodological chemistry with broad practical impact in structural biology, materials science and drug development.

title: Magnetic resonance imaging
motivation: Discoveries concerning magnetic resonance imaging.
explanation: A striking case of deep physical principles becoming a mature, ubiquitous medical imaging technology.

title: Graphene
motivation: Groundbreaking experiments regarding the two-dimensional material graphene.
explanation: A fundamental materials discovery with active applications in electronics, composites, sensors and energy, though broad industrial dominance remains uneven.

title: Gravitational waves
motivation: Decisive contributions to the LIGO detector and observation of gravitational waves.
explanation: A fundamental confirmation of general relativity and a new observational channel, enabled by extraordinary precision technology but with limited direct industrial adoption so far.

title: Lithium-ion batteries
motivation: Development of lithium-ion batteries.
explanation: A technology-oriented scientific achievement that became foundational to mobile electronics, electric vehicles and energy storage.

title: CRISPR genome editing
motivation: Development of a method for genome editing.
explanation: A mechanistic biological insight rapidly converted into a broadly reusable engineering platform for genome editing.

title: Entangled photons and Bell inequalities
motivation: Experiments with entangled photons, establishing violations of Bell inequalities and pioneering quantum information science.
explanation: Deep tests of quantum foundations now underpin quantum communication, sensing and information technologies.

title: Quantum dots
motivation: Discovery and synthesis of quantum dots.
explanation: Nanoscale quantum effects became manufacturable components in displays, imaging and emerging optoelectronics.

title: Foundations of machine learning with neural networks
motivation: Foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks.
explanation: A highly influential bridge between physics-inspired computation and modern AI, with exceptionally broad technological deployment.

title: Computational protein design and structure prediction
motivation: Computational protein design and protein structure prediction.
explanation: Fundamental structural biology combined with advanced computation, already reshaping biotechnology and drug discovery workflows.

title: Macroscopic quantum tunnelling in an electric circuit
motivation: Macroscopic quantum mechanical tunnelling and energy quantisation in an electric circuit.
explanation: A fundamental quantum phenomenon demonstrated in engineered circuits, directly relevant to superconducting quantum technologies.

title: Metal-organic frameworks
motivation: Development of metal-organic frameworks.
explanation: A materials-platform breakthrough with applications in gas storage, separations, carbon capture, catalysis and water harvesting.

title: Peripheral immune tolerance
motivation: Discoveries concerning peripheral immune tolerance.
explanation: A fundamental immunology advance with important implications for autoimmune disease, transplantation and immunotherapy.
